brief: THE BET. The wind is a magnitude (windF(), windTarget() = max(windyDay hash, frontWind)) with no direction: every consumer leans +x — the washing, smoke, bunting, fountain spray, river streaks, cloud drift, rain droplets, and the shed leaves' vx, which is why #66's litter heaps EAST of every tree in every seed (c102). Give the wind a SIGN: one per front / windy day (a hash of the day, latched when the target rises from calm so it cannot flip mid-blow), and make every consumer that has an x-lean multiply by it, so an east-wind day leans the whole town the other way and its litter lies west of the linden. Take c101 in the same pass: `windyDay()` is `hash(day, 99)` with no seed, so every seed shares one windy calendar — salt it with the seed. At sign +1 every consumer must reduce exactly to today.
successLooksLike: wind-front.mjs and wind-year.mjs anchors unchanged for magnitude; a new probe prints the sign per windy spell across 10 seeds × 30 d (roughly half each way, never flipping inside a spell); litter-year.mjs shows the linden's heap centroid west of the trunk on a west-sign autumn day and east on an east-sign one; a windy noon crop pair (sign +1 vs −1) with every lean mirrored and nothing else different; sign +1 whole-frame hash identical to HEAD at a pinned windy instant; 10 seeds no longer share the windy calendar.
avoid: Do not add a compass or a vane — the lean IS the reading. Do not let the sign change while windF > 0.1. Do not reshuffle the seeded stream with a new R() — hash only.
